title: Billing and Coding: Bisphosphonate Drug Therapy

codes.1: Intravenous administration by infusion should be billed with procedure code 96365 for first hour and procedure code 96366 for each additional hour. If the administration is by IV push, use procedure code 96374.

covered.1: Note: Diagnosis codes must be coded to the highest level of specificity. J3489 Zoledronic acid To report low bone mass for procedure code J3489 use diagnosis code M81.0 - Age-related osteoporosis without current pathological fracture. For codes in the table below that require a 7th character, letter A initial encounter for fracture, D subsequent encounter for fracture with routine healing, G subsequent encounter for fracture with delayed healing, K for subsequent encounter for fracture with nonunion, P for subsequent encounter for fracture with malunion, or S sequela may be used.
